input:
required scenes (story order):
S1: in ancient times, people did not know which plants can be eaten, so people often got sick after eating some plants
S2: 神农decided to find out which plants are safe to eat and which are not, so he climbed mountains to try different plants
S3: 神农found茶and took a record
S4: 神农tried 夹竹桃 and fainted
S5: a person in blue stopped by and gave灵芝to 神农，神农felt better after eating灵芝
S6: another person in brown came by and had a conversation with 神农
S7: 神农takes record of灵芝and夹竹桃

learner's story:
在古代 ，人们爱吃东西，所以东西一看就吃了。除了植物以外，其他的东西人们都不想吃。在地上开着很多植物。有的很好吃，有的有毒。可是一位叫神农的老人觉得无论植物，都味道不太好，所以他决定去山上找什么植物很好吃。他走啊走啊，植物一看就吃了。对他来说，这个植物的味道是最好。他叫这个植物茶，记下每种好吃的茶。有一天，神农走到了一个很美的地方。那儿开着黄色的花，又漂亮又香。他吃花了。可是一吃就肚子疼，难受得不得了。他想：我会死吗？这时，一个穿着蓝色衣服的男人正好过来，赶快拿起来像伞的植物，给神农吃了。神农问他：这个植物是什么？蓝衣男人说：“这个植物除了很好吃以外，我也不知道。”像伞的植物神农决定叫灵芝，叫黄花“夹竹桃”。一个穿着咖啡色衣服的男人走过来，问神农：你怎么了？神农说：我吃坏肚子了。我发现了黄色的花不好吃，有毒。我也发现了很好吃的植物，像伞的植物很好吃。我觉得神农帮了千千万万的人 ，因为他找到很多好吃的植物。

scenes.core: people do not know safe plants and get sick after eating them
evidence: 在古代 ，人们爱吃东西，所以东西一看就吃了。
scenes.missing_part: People often got sick after eating plants because they did not know which plants were safe.

scenes.core: 神农 decides to identify safe and unsafe plants and tries plants in the mountains
evidence: 可是一位叫神农的老人觉得无论植物，都味道不太好，所以他决定去山上找什么植物很好吃。
他走啊走啊，植物一看就吃了。
scenes.missing_part: 神农's purpose of finding which plants were safe to eat and which were not.

scenes.core: 神农 finds 茶 and records it
evidence: 他叫这个植物茶，记下每种好吃的茶。

scenes.core: 神农 eats 夹竹桃 and faints
evidence: 可是一吃就肚子疼，难受得不得了。
像伞的植物神农决定叫灵芝，叫黄花“夹竹桃”。
scenes.missing_part: 神农 fainted after trying 夹竹桃.

scenes.core: a blue-clothed person gives 神农 灵芝, and 神农 feels better after eating it
evidence: 这时，一个穿着蓝色衣服的男人正好过来，赶快拿起来像伞的植物，给神农吃了。
像伞的植物神农决定叫灵芝，叫黄花“夹竹桃”。
scenes.missing_part: 神农 felt better after eating 灵芝.

scenes.core: a brown-clothed person comes and talks with 神农
evidence: 一个穿着咖啡色衣服的男人走过来，问神农：你怎么了？

scenes.core: 神农 records 灵芝 and 夹竹桃
scenes.missing_part: 神农 took a record of both 灵芝 and 夹竹桃.

wrong_information.learner_text: 所以他决定去山上找什么植物很好吃。
wrong_information.problem: This gives 神农 a different goal: he should decide to find out which plants are safe to eat and which are unsafe, rather than only which plants taste good.

wrong_information.learner_text: 可是一吃就肚子疼，难受得不得了。
wrong_information.problem: This replaces the required outcome after eating 夹竹桃: 神农 should faint.

feedback: Before 神农 decides to go to the mountains, add that people often got sick because they did not know which plants were safe to eat.
When 神农 goes to the mountains before finding 茶, say that he wants to learn which plants are safe and which are unsafe.
After 神农 eats the yellow 夹竹桃 and before the blue-clothed man arrives, say that he faints.
After the blue-clothed man gives 神农 灵芝, add that 神农 feels better after eating it.
After 神农 talks with the brown-clothed man, add that he records both 灵芝 and 夹竹桃.
